turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not be produced again.
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I can't give medical advice, including which ointment to use. For any health question, such as a possible allergic reaction to tattoo ink, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, please do. A doctor is the right person to ask. If you need anything about our prints or an order, I'm happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand. Unfortunately, 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop. It is never restocked and can't be reserved, so I can't get you a copy. I'm sorry. If you'd like, I can help with another print or an order.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and I can't promise a copy if one turns up. Is there anything else I can help with?
